digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler retry and outcome framework
propositions: One provider-neutral operation/outcome contract unifies nested retry boundaries across Cloud ACLI and DC SDK to prevent timeout-multiplied Jira writes and ambiguous recovery.

Cloud summary routes invoke at most one ACLI process per write with bounded recovery; DC routes execute exactly GET-PUT-GET per invocation with no hidden repeats, all within three invocations and 15 seconds cumulative sleep.

Jira idempotency absence requires observe-before-replay: desired summary observed after timeout recovers as success; conclusive old state permits only remaining-budget replay; failed/inconclusive observation returns non-replaying commit_unknown.

Constructor-injected executor selector defaults to legacy (no config/env surface), tests explicitly enable new route, mixed-field updates stay one legacy call, and S1 test-only implementation preserves apply_handlers boundary for S3 cutover.

DC executor passes max_retries=0 to jira.JIRA and fails fast unless _session.max_retries == 0, validated offline against real jira 3.10.5 library before executor logic layers on; legacy SDK retry unchanged.

Every terminal outcome records exactly one redacted per-mutation message (≤512 code points), completion log contains only logical id/disposition/counts/cleanup/retry_not_before/message (≤1,024 total), no baseline/provenance advance or S1 deferral in S1.
